summary: Iteration 67 testing completed - All 4 features verified: PCMN similarity guard (class 6/7), expense category similarity guard, bundle-preview-block endpoint, and fiscal lock fallback. 13/13 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: 1. _norm_pcmn_name() normalizes names: lowercase, remove accents, remove special chars
2. _pcmn_names_similar() checks: exact match, substring match (a in b or b in a), >70% word overlap
3. Guard only applies to class 6/7 accounts (charges/produits)
4. Returns 409 with helpful message showing existing similar account
1. _norm_cat_name() and _cat_names_similar() use same logic as PCMN
2. Checks all existing categories in the ACP before creation
3. Returns 409 with message showing existing similar category
1. GET /api/invoices/bundle-preview-block requires session_id and pages params
2. Returns 404 for invalid/expired session_id with message 'Session bundle introuvable ou expiree'
4. Route correctly placed BEFORE /invoices/{invoice_id} to avoid shadowing
1. ensure_period_open() first tries fast string comparison for fiscal year lookup
2. If no match, falls back to loading all fiscal years and comparing with datetime.strptime
3. Handles edge cases where date format in DB might differ
4. Returns helpful diagnostic message listing existing fiscal years when date is outside any period
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary PCMN accounts, expense categories, fiscal years, and invoices with unique timestamps to avoid conflicts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features from iter67 are working correctly. The similarity guards use normalized name comparison with substring and word overlap detection. The bundle-preview-block endpoint is correctly positioned before the parameterized route.
